name: @role-orchestrator/expand
description: M4-03 bounded repair and re-review graph expansion (A20). When a review node's durable verdict for an exact candidateSha is fail (read via @role-orchestrator/review's A12 query, never taken on faith), the expander appends TWO new nodes to the run's node set - a fix node (role of the repaired node, dependency = the repaired node) and a re-review node (reviewer, dependency = the fix node). New nodes are pure appends: no existing row's dependency snapshot is ever rewritten, and the FULL composed graph is re-validated with @role-orchestrator/dag's validator (parse + cycles + budgets) BEFORE any write, so the graph stays acyclic and a back edge can only exist as a rejected request. Review generations are bounded at maxReviewRounds=3 per chain INCLUDING the first review (ORCHESTRATION.md section 5): a fourth-round request is refused with the typed ReviewRoundsExhaustedError and the run is durably held for user disposition - nothing is minted, nothing auto-continues. Expansion is idempotent per (run, failed review node, candidateSha): a replayed fail returns the SAME fix/review pair. Minted nodes are ordinary task_nodes rows, so the existing scheduler dispatch and the dag FAILED -> RETRY_PENDING -> READY edges apply unchanged; the re-review node consumes the NEW candidateSha through the M2-05 review protocol, to which the old fail never applies (A12).
